question: Does fine-tuning nli-deberta-v3-xsmall on GitHub issue->PR pairs from held-out repos lift U2 (error resolved?) above the best prior arm?

machine.description: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (8C/16T), WSL2 20 GB; training on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 10 GB

machine_load_note: Scoring and training ran beside a CPU-bound LongMemEval benchmark (1-minute load 8-19 on 16 threads); latencies are recorded but not comparable to other runs.

verdict.summary: The tuned model clearly beats the untuned base. It does not clear the 0.70 bar or the best prior arm (Laya typed-decisions) at 95%, and on the Axil-sourced slice Laya ranks first.
verdict.bar_0_70: not met at 95%: per-seed cluster lower bounds 0.719, 0.699, 0.721
verdict.vs_base: paired gain 0.182 to 0.194; lower bounds 0.044 to 0.069, all above 0
verdict.vs_laya: paired gain 0.099 to 0.112; 95% intervals from -0.021 to +0.226; 1 of 3 intervals exclude 0

axil_subset.note: 15 test rows (10 negatives): too few to decide, but it is the only slice from Axil's own records

by_negative_group.note: state negatives (the same bug, not fixed) are the ones a deployed judge meets after Axil's topic filter; there are 4, no evidence either way

verdict.sibling_repo_ablation: one seed: 0.808 without the test repos' sibling projects against 0.807 with them; within seed noise (sd 0.006)
verdict.u1_side_effect: U1 AUROC 0.745 untuned, 0.683 to 0.689 tuned: the tuned model is U2-only, never a U1 judge
verdict.operating_point: test FPR at the train-fit threshold 0.070 to 0.123, above the 0.05 target, and optimistic: test rows share issues with the rows the threshold is fit on. A top-3 suggestion list per error would rely on per-error ranking, which pooled AUROC does not measure; it is unmeasured
verdict.limits: 111 test rows in 56 dependent clusters; 42 of 57 test negatives are fixes for another bug; repo-level correlation is not modelled. Not for README, docs or CLI output (see the typed-decisions README numbers policy).

U1.question: Does the NEW statement replace, update, or contradict the OLD statement, so that the OLD statement is no longer current?

U2.question: Does the LATER note show that the ERROR has actually been fixed?

u2_test_paired_vs_base.bootstrap: 2000 cluster resamples, shared by every arm (paired); repo-level correlation not modelled

u2_test_paired_vs_laya.bootstrap: 2000 cluster resamples, shared by every arm (paired); repo-level correlation not modelled
